## Scope

- [ ] Scope is limited to this task/PR.
- [ ] No Production secrets/server/DB access.
- [ ] No release or deployment.
- [ ] No direct `main` changes.

## Closeout

- [ ] `IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE` evidence is included.
- [ ] `GIT CLOSEOUT COMPLETE` evidence is included.
- [ ] `STAGE CLOSED` is not claimed before owner merge/close decision.
- [ ] Commit SHA and branch are listed.
- [ ] Test results are listed.
- [ ] CI/status checks are inspected.

## Repository Hygiene

- [ ] `git status --short --branch` was reviewed.
- [ ] Untracked files were classified.
- [ ] No blind `git add -A` was used.
- [ ] Runtime/local artifact files are not committed.
- [ ] Secret scan covered changed/added files.
- [ ] Generated governance output has canonical source plus changelog/amendment evidence, or was restored.

## Owner Decision

Merge requires one explicit owner answer in the task. Production confirmation is separate from merge approval.
